$revision: v3 · founder direction: bespoke refined every detail thought about · scene bigger than character · golden-ratio character position · compose like an architect draws a plan · high-fashion editorial lighting

$compositional_discipline.principle_1: The scene must feel bigger than the character in it.
$compositional_discipline.principle_2: Character positioned at a golden-ratio intersection point (φ = 1.618 → 0.382 or 0.618 along each axis). Lower φ-points (contemplative) preferred.
$compositional_discipline.principle_3: Every scene is composed like an architect's site plan — foreground / midground / background planes named, sight-lines drawn, light direction specified in clock terms, depth cues articulated per plane.
$compositional_discipline.principle_4: Every visible element is intentional. No defaults. No generics. No accidents.
$compositional_discipline.principle_5: High-fashion editorial lighting register (Lindbergh · Weber · Leibovitz · Roversi) — not documentary, not nature photography.

scenes.name: coffee-shop-sapling
scenes.prompt: Bespoke editorial photograph. ARCHITECTURAL COMPOSITION PLAN (composed like an architect draws a site plan, every element placed by intention): Frame is 16:9 wide anamorphic landscape. Character sits at the golden-ratio intersection at approximately 61.8% from left · 61.8% from top (lower-right φ-point), occupying less than 22% of frame height, small in the vast interior around her. FOREGROUND PLANE (left third · 0-33% frame width): the handmade walnut and blackened-steel service counter cuts diagonally across the lower-left, La Marzocco Linea Classic AV espresso machine in cream lacquer as sculptural silhouette, one antique brass Edison-bulb pendant light hanging in from the top-left corner, softly bokeh-blurred. MIDGROUND PLANE (center-right · 33-70%): a small round Carrara marble table with antique-brass base, and the young woman seated at it, in sharp focus, angled three-quarters away from camera toward the window. BACKGROUND PLANE (right two-thirds · 30-100%): a floor-to-ceiling east-facing window fills the vertical, filling the right half of the frame; through the glass at soft focus is the street where city workers in canvas-tan work jackets and burnt-sienna beanies are actively placing a very young Japanese Zelkova sapling (~1.2m tall) into a fresh sidewalk cutout, burlap root ball still visible at base, ceremonial planting motion, wood tree stakes beside the hole. LIGHT DIRECTION: motivated natural key from the east-facing window at 9 o'clock, 30-degree elevation, soft cool morning light; overhead Edison-bulb pendants provide warm ambient counter-light at 2700K but stay subordinate. BESPOKE DETAIL: The woman is early-twenties, dark hair in a low natural knot, wearing an artisan-knit cream Aran cardigan in Norwegian wool with a cable pattern, slim tailored charcoal wool trousers, one thin gold chain. Both hands anatomically resolved: one wraps a matte off-white handmade thick-walled ceramic cup (East Fork Pottery register) with steam curling upward, the other rests flat on the marble beside the saucer. Interior further considered: nordic-oak wide-plank floors receding into depth, exposed dark steel beams above, warm off-white plaster walls, one small ficus in a matte terracotta pot on the far counter, no branded signage anywhere. HIGH-FASHION EDITORIAL LIGHTING (Peter Lindbergh window-portraiture register): sculptural single-source natural key, deep controlled negative fill on the woman's shadow side producing painterly chiaroscuro, rim light through her hair from the window. DEPTH CUES: foreground counter and pendant bokeh-blurred (out of focus), midground woman sharp (in focus), background sapling-planting scene very soft focus behind glass. SHOT SPEC: ARRI ALEXA 65 with Zeiss Master Anamorphic 40mm, aperture f/2.0, Kodak Vision3 500T warm film grain. Locked static camera. No text, no logos, no LED elements, no readable menu. THEMATIC LAYER (the beauty of technology done right): the technology this woman uses to run her work is invisible in the frame — no laptop, no phone, no LED, no screen anywhere; only her presence, the ceramic cup, the marble, the light, and the world outside remain. The beauty is that technology has bought her this hour of contemplation, not stolen it. Quiet. Contemplative. Bespoke. Production-grade.

scenes.name: amalfi-porsche-olive
scenes.prompt: Bespoke editorial photograph. ARCHITECTURAL COMPOSITION PLAN (composed like an architect draws a site plan, every element placed by intention): Frame is 16:9 wide anamorphic landscape. Character stands at the golden-ratio intersection at approximately 38.2% from left · 61.8% from top (lower-left φ-point), occupying less than 20% of frame height, small against the vast Amalfi coastal vista. FOREGROUND PLANE (bottom-left third · 0-40% frame width, lower 60% frame height): the vintage 1989 Porsche 911 Carrera 3.2 Coupé is parked in profile-forward three-quarter angle, its long-and-low silhouette cutting across the lower-left of the frame, occupying roughly 35% of frame width, warm patina catching golden light on its Grand Prix White paint; the traditional Amalfi dry-stone wall of mortar-free warm limestone field stones runs beneath the car and continues across the frame. MIDGROUND PLANE (at the golden-ratio point): the Italian man stands beside the driver's-side door of the Porsche in three-quarter back to camera, weight on one hip, small in the composition, briefly glancing down at his phone in his right hand. BACKGROUND PLANE (upper 60% and right 60% · dominates the composition): the Mediterranean Sea spreads wide into hazy blue infinity, horizon line at approximately 40% from top; terraced hillsides above and below stepped with dry-stone walls, lemon and olive groves visible in far background; the monumental ancient Rotondella olive tree (Olea europaea var. Rotondella, ~500 years old) is rooted into the terraced wall in the RIGHT third of the frame, its 3-5 gnarled trunks emerging from a single ancient root ball with deeply fissured gray-brown bark, its silver-green crown reaching approximately 6 meters tall into the upper-right third catching raking golden-hour light as pale mint. LIGHT DIRECTION: golden-hour sun from camera-right at 4 o'clock, 20-degree elevation (low warm raking light from the western cliff); warm rim light separates the olive canopy and the Porsche paint from the softer terraced background; deep controlled negative fill on the shadow side of the man's face and body. BESPOKE DETAIL: The man is early-sixties, warm Mediterranean skin weathered from sun, thick salt-and-pepper hair (mostly gray at temples, silver at crown), natural stubble. He wears a crisp pale sky-blue linen shirt with unbuttoned collar (Loro Piana register), pale sand unlined linen trousers (Officine Générale register), leather Chelsea boots in patinated cognac (Church's register), Persol Ratti tortoise aviator sunglasses model 649 pushed up on his head, vintage Rolex Datejust 1601 on tan leather strap. Both hands anatomically resolved. Porsche further considered: classic narrow-body silhouette faithful to 1989 Carrera 3.2 body geometry, impact bumpers, whale-tail ducktail rear spoiler in body color, round pop-up headlights with chrome bezels, chrome window trim, Fuchs 5-spoke starburst forged alloy wheels polished silver with black centers, black leather sport interior visible through side window, rear Italian license plate present in correct format, warm patina from being kept and driven (not showroom shine), body proportion long-and-low (NOT stubby). HIGH-FASHION EDITORIAL LIGHTING (Bruce Weber coastal fashion crossed with Paolo Roversi soft-focus painterly register): sculptural motivated golden-hour side-light, warm rim, deep controlled fill. DEPTH CUES: foreground car and wall sharp (in focus), midground man sharp (in focus), background olive tree in slight focus fall-off, far Mediterranean and terraces at atmospheric haze. SHOT SPEC: ARRI ALEXA 65 with Zeiss Master Anamorphic 40mm, aperture f/2.8, Kodak Vision3 500T warm film grain. Locked static camera. No readable license plates, no visible face detail on the man (three-quarter back), no readable phone screen, no text, no logos. THEMATIC LAYER (the beauty of technology done right): the phone in his right hand is the ONLY visible technology in the frame — no laptop, no LED, no screen glow, no wires; everything else is the vintage-machined Porsche, the ancient olive, the dry-stone wall, the linen, the leather, the Mediterranean, the golden light. The beauty is that technology has bought him this hour on this coast at sixty, not stolen it. Majestic, nostalgic, sun-soaked, sacred stillness. Paolo Sorrentino contemplative warmth. Bespoke. Production-grade.
